iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSC
       Namespace PSC

DESCRIPTION
       PEM Subscriber Context (PSC) is a temporary object that is created while the DCHP or RADIUS AAA transaction is in progress.
       When the transaction ends, the data stored in the PSC is used to create or update the subscriber session. As such, the PSC
       commands allow the iRule developer to access (read, write) the subscriber attributes while the subscriber is being
       discovered or authorized.

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
